sections.title: Languages
sections.description: Which languages content is translated into, and what the source is assumed to be.

fields.title: Source Language
fields.help_text: Language code the original content is written in. Defaults to the site language.

fields.title: Target Languages
fields.help_text: One entry per language you want translations produced in.

fields.title: Post Types to Translate
fields.help_text: Only these post types offer a translate action.

fields.title: Preserve HTML markup
fields.help_text: Ask the model to keep tags, attributes and shortcodes untouched and translate only the text between them.

fields.title: Extra Instructions
fields.help_text: Appended to every translation request. Use it for tone, terminology or names that should not be translated.
